messages:
sam (release-lead): Heads up — scheduled prod deploy at 23:00 UTC during the quiet window. release=service-api@1.12.4. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m waits. Will monitor p99/err and rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for 23:00 UTC. Canary targets: infra-canary-1..3. Auto-notify on >2% error or deploy timeout >10m. Link: https://internal.redwood/release/1.12.4

maya (platform): Thanks. Please reference runbook for this pattern: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/quiet-window-deploys — backout steps at the top.

alex (sre): Confirm surge protocol: if p99 latency > 300ms OR client error rate > 3% sustained for 3m, initiate traffic-shed to standby cluster and pin previous version. Criteria = 3m sustained across two consecutive checks.

lee (prod-eng): Noted. Quick pin command for ops: ```rdwctl pin service-api --version 1.12.3 --reason "emergency backout"``` Keep me posted, I'll watch canary dashboards.

chris (oncall): Also call out rollback vs rollforward metric: prefer rollforward if regression is minor and can be mitigated in-flight. If regressions affect >10% of requests or customer-facing errors spike, do full backout.

sam (release-lead): Agree. Actionable checklist I want in chat during the canary: 1) canary metrics snapshot, 2) grep logs for 5xx spike, 3) result of `rdwctl pin` if taken, 4) deploy-bot status.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 23:01:12 UTC. 10% traffic routed. Metric checks scheduled every 60s.

maya (platform): Backout runbook quick link (edited): https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/backout-protocols#quiet-window — includes surge-shift play and pin authorizers.

lee (prod-eng): If we need to pin and unblock traffic fast: ``rdwctl rollback --service service-api --to 1.12.3 --force`` then run ``rdwctl unpin --service service-api`` only after validated.

chris (oncall): I'll keep pager on. If I trigger pin, I'll post command and tag @sam @lee.

alex (sre): Reminder: we have a standby cluster in us-west that can take 30% of traffic automatically under surge-shed. That is configured in traffic-router v2. Check traceroutes if connectivity looks odd.

sam (release-lead): Sweet. Post-deploy notes: update release notes with rollout percentages and any manual pins. If any backout happens, include timestamps and `rdwctl` audit output.

deploy-bot: Canary at 23:06:12 UTC -> metrics OK. No alerts. Promoting to 50% now.

lee (prod-eng): Watching logs. p99=120ms, errors ~0.2%. No action yet. :thumbsup:

chris (oncall): Good. I'll close the loop after 100% or any incident.

sam (release-lead): Thanks everyone. Keep this thread updated if you take any manual action (pin/rollback/traffic-shift).
